inScope: every Phase 1 declaration kind—state, struct, enum, const, event, error, initializer, entry, view, pure fn, invariant, extension requirement, and proof reference—has parser positive/negative vectors and stable Source AST binding

accepted declaration type spellings—the closed primitive/integer-width/Bool/Field bn254_fr/Principal/Unit set and the bounded Option, Bytes N, and Array N recursive family—are decoded exactly, with unknown or alternate spellings rejected fail closed
declaration-order duplicate names and cross-kind callable namespace collisions are rejected with deterministic validation priority
direct Lean command elaboration and ParserSession Loader decoding of the same declaration source produce the same declaration-level Source AST and sourceHash
outOfScope: name/type checking, pure-fn call-graph checking, and invariant/proof-reference type-level binding owned by TASK-D2-01 and TST-TYPE-001 through TST-TYPE-003
statement/expression grammar or statement-level parity owned by TASK-D1-04 and TST-SRC-005, including statements that merely appear inside declaration fixtures
attribute export, multi-program selection, stable diagnostics, or contained frontend worker behavior owned by TASK-D1-05 through TASK-D1-08
Typed or Semantic lowering, requirement solving, Plan/TargetIR, target materialization, deployment, runtime, proof, or verification
any new declaration kind, declaration type spelling, or type-level semantic requirement not already accepted by the task authority and language specification
doneWhen: lake build Tests.Language.DeclarationAcceptance proof_forge_next_tests exits zero and lake env .lake/build/bin/proof-forge-next-tests exits zero with the frozen TST-SRC-004 assertions enabled

TASK-D1-02 is done and candidate-bound passed evidence for TST-SRC-004 has qualification=formal under the existing formal finalization rules; the development evidence listed on the TASK-D1-03 row and any other development evidence are insufficient

overflowPolicy: Any new declaration kind, spelling, or type-level semantic requirement goes to a separately approved TASK; it must not be added to this package after activation.
notes: Pending preparation only, permitted by the task-freeze checker. D1-PA-03 through D1-PA-80 development evidence does not activate TASK-D1-03 or close formal TST-SRC-004. TST-SRC-004 asserts parser and Source AST behavior only and never closes D2 type tests.
